units: <cite ref="Eruvin 54a:1-16">Erub. 54ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Proverbs 1:9">Prov. I, 9</cite>) <he>אם … כע׳ זה שרף על וכ׳</he> if a man trains himself to be like a necklace which is loose around the neck, and is (sometimes) seen and (sometimes) not seen (i.e. is yielding and modest), his learning will be established &c.; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 929">Yalk. Prov. 929</cite> <he>שיפה לצואר</he> (read: <cite ref="U02014"><he>שרָפֶה</he></cite>).

<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 675:1">Yalk. Ps. 675</cite> the Law is <he>ע׳ לצואר</he> a chain for the neck (<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 12:3">Lev. R. s. 12</cite> <cite ref="M00539"><he>מונייק</he></cite>).

<cite ref="Bava Batra 75a:6">B. Bath. 75ᵃ</cite> <he>לא זכה עושין לו ע׳</he> if he is not worthy, they will make a chain for him. [<cite ref="Bava Batra 75a:6">Ib.</cite> <he>זכה עושין לו ע׳</he> if he is worthy, they will make a necklace for him; omitted in Ms. R.; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 9.]—Pl. <he>עֲנָקִים</he>.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 26:7">Gen. R. s. 26</cite> (they are called ʿĂnaḳim) <he>שהיו מרבים ע׳ ע״ג עֳנָקִים</he> they increased the chains around the necks (subjugated many people); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 47:1">Yalk. ib. 47</cite>.
